title: Telkea
description: telkea.com Telkea Group is a Luxembourg IT and telecom integrator founded in 1929 as Societe Luxembourgeoise de Telephonie, a pioneer in telephone equipment rental, rebranded Telkea in 2016 and still family owned by the Giler family. Headquartered in Luxembourg Hamm with about 150 to 160 employees, it unites four companies, Telkea ICT, a PSF licensed IT integrator with 28.9 million euro revenue, Telkea Telecom, an operator since 1998, Telkea Soft, business software maker of the GestoMed medical app, and Telkea Security, a 2024 spin off handling building and personal security plus audiovisual solutions. It serves 3000 plus clients in finance, healthcare, transport and the public sector, including airports, hospitals and the FC Metz stadium. With its own data centers, cloud services, Cisco and Alcatel partnerships and the Telkea Academy, the group doubled revenue and headcount in five years and won over 6 million euro in recent government contracts.
